description: This PHP file contains the 'Translation' controller class within the OpenCart admin module. It manages tasks related to generating, writing, and clearing translation files for the catalog module, including listing translation routes, creating JSON translation files, and deleting existing ones.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Controller class for managing catalog translations, including listing translation routes, creating JSON translation files, and clearing translation cache.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of translation tasks to process catalog language files for different stores and languages.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Creates a JSON translation file for a specific route, store, and language based on retrieved translation data.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing JSON translation files for all stores and languages to clear cached translations.
